summary_en: This study performs longitudinal photoacoustic imaging at five time points in Non-Hodgkin lymphoma xenografts to quantify Hb, HbO2, HbT, and mean oxygen saturation. summary_en: PAT-Mamba is a blind all-in-one restoration framework for multiple practical photoacoustic tomography degradations, including sparse channels, limited angular sampling, bandwidth loss, and noise. It combines selective state-space TransMamba blocks with adaptive frequency learning and reports competitive or improved performance across embryo simulation, in-vivo mouse, and clinical artery datasets.

summary_en: This prospective study evaluates co-registered acoustic-resolution photoacoustic microscopy and ultrasound endoscopy for identifying pathological complete response after neoadjuvant rectal-cancer therapy. A ResNet50 model trained on ARPAM-US B-scans achieved promising cross-validated discrimination and was compared with T2-weighted MRI radiomics models, although the small prospective cohort requires external validation.
